  • Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
  • Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
  • Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
  • Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
  • Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
  • Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
  • Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
What you'll bring:
  • Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
  • Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
  • Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
  • The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
  • The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
  • Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
  • Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
  • Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
  • An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â

  • A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ

  • Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
  • A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
  • Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â  Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

  • We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
  • We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers.   • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others

  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation

  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

Â

Â

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

Strongly preferred

Why Now

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Company Tessera Labs AI

About the Role

Tessera Labs AI is a technology product firm delivering next-generation, AI-accelerated enterprise transformation programs. We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Cloud Lead to own the Logistics and Supply Chain Management (SCM) workstream for a greenfield Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation for a fast-growing client.

This is a greenfield implementation from a process and configuration standpoint â there is no legacy SCM configuration to reverse-engineer or carry forward, and the opportunity is to stand up Oracle Fusion Cloud Inventory Management, Order Management, Indirect Procurement and related logistics processes from a blank slate, configured to Oracle standard wherever possible. Data is a different story: item, article, inventory, and other master and historical data still needs to be extracted, transformed, and loaded (ETL) from the client's legacy ERP into Oracle Fusion, and this role supports that migration effort alongside the functional design work.

This is a highly cross-functional, business-facing role. You will run discovery and design workshops directly with logistics, supply chain, and procurement stakeholders â including ownership of the Indirect Procurement value stream â translate their requirements into working Oracle Fusion design and configuration, and own the documentation trail from business requirement through configuration and test. You will also own the integration design connecting Oracle Fusion to Shopify for e-commerce order and inventory synchronization, and to the client'swarehouse management system(s) for outbound and inbound logistics â alongside integration with adjacent Oracle Fusion modules as applicable.

This is a nearshore delivery role, based in Mexico or Brazil, working in a remote-first model alongside Tessera's distributed FDE delivery and AI engineering teams. \n

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. title: Regional Field CTO
Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Light Amplification Lead (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

  • Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

  • Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

  • Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

  • Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.

Who You Are

  • You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

  • Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

  • Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

  • Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

  • People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

  • Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.

    Nice to have

  • Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

  • Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

  • Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

  • Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

  • Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

  • A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.


Why work with Us?

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds.

Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. title: Account Executive (AE) | DACH (d/f/m)
description:
About the role

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

Unlike traditional transactional sales, you'll be selling complex supply chain software to technical buyers—requiring deep discovery, consultative selling, and the ability to prove measurable ROI in a trillion-dollar industry. You'll sell software that directly impacts how electronics companies—from automotive suppliers to industrial equipment manufacturers—manage their complete electronics supply chain. The impact is tangible, the industry is fascinating, and the growth trajectory is yours to shape.

Who you are

  • You’ve sold B2B software, and you can walk through your own numbers from memory: quota, attainment, average deal size, how long your ramp took

  • You’ve built something that didn’t exist before you — a segment, a first playbook, a function nobody had staffed, a company of your own. You’re more comfortable without a playbook than with an inherited one

  • You use AI as more than a better search engine. You’ve built your own automations, workflows, or tools, and you can name what you shipped and what came of it

  • You’ve been close to how electronics or physical products actually get made — manufacturing, hardware, or supply chain. A bonus rather than a must, and the strongest single signal we look for, because it’s what lets you find the pain before a customer names it

  • You’re consultative by instinct. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so short cycles with demo-ready buyers aren’t the motion here

  • You work in German and English at a professional level. Discovery, demos, and negotiation happen in German; the company runs in English

Your potential growth path:

  • Months 1-6: Master the product, close your first 5-10 deals, build your DACH network

  • Months 6-18: Take on larger deals, navigate complex stakeholder environments, mentor BDRs

  • 18+ months: Transition to Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs

Your performance objectives

📣 Generate pipeline

  • Build your network. Connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter through industry events, LinkedIn, and targeted outreach. Establish Luminovo's presence at 2-3 key industry fairs annually.

  • Generate qualified pipeline. Create €240k-€400k in qualified pipeline ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) through outbound prospecting, events, and inbound lead qualification using SPICED discovery.

  • Qualify with precision. Run customer-centric discovery to uncover Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, and Decision criteria. Quantify potential value before investing in lengthy sales cycles.

💪 Close opportunities

  • Inspire with demos. Deliver product demonstrations tailored to each customer's pain points. Clearly articulate our competitive positioning.

  • Prove measurable value. Collaborate with domain experts to run workshops that demonstrate ROI through concrete impact calculations (time savings, cost reductions, efficiency gains).

  • Close strategically. Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys, map stakeholders, and turn negotiations into win-win outcomes. Close €60k-€100k in new ARR per quarter (depending on seniority) with smooth handovers to Customer Success.

💡 Build expertise

  • Become an industry insider. Develop deep knowledge of electronics supply chains and feed customer insights back to product teams.

  • Master consultative selling. Make SPICED your guiding principle and build expertise in technical SaaS sales with longer cycles and multi-stakeholder decisions.

📈 Lead by example

  • Own your metrics. Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates, and deal velocity. Use data to consistently hit quarterly targets.

  • Enable your peers. Mentor junior AEs through shadowing and deal reviews. Contribute to our sales playbook.

  • Embrace feedback. Reflect on every major customer interaction and proactively seek coaching to maximize impact.

🇪🇺 Your territory

You'll primarily cover the German-speaking market (DACH), with some English-speaking territories. Fluency in 🇩🇪 German and 🇬🇧 English is essential.

 

📍 Work location

Munich headquarters or Berlin satellite office (both in hybrid setup with home-office flexibility). Our sales team meets in the office three days per week. Occasional travel for team retreats and industry events (expenses covered).

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales — Your manager who'll coach you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, Co-Founder — Provides strategic guidance on positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and Pioneer AE for OEM — Your primary partner in building the OEM sales playbook

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps — Provide CRM support, dashboards, and sales enablement

  • Marketing, Customer Success & Product teams — Regular collaboration on campaigns, customer onboarding, and product roadmap

💡 Skills, knowledge, and expertise

Just so you know—we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care about your CV.

If you're interested to find out more about why we banned requirements from our performance profiles—see here.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

title: Senior Associate Information Security Consultant
description:

Do you want to rethink information security consulting with AI? Are you excited to automate repetitive work, move faster and spend more time solving real customer challenges? Join us to combine your InfoSec expertise with AI, challenge inefficient ways of working and help shape how AI is used in security consulting.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • You own and develop customer relationships across the full lifecycle of our InfoSec-SaaS product, acting as a trusted advisor on information security.

  • You advise customers on complex security challenges and build pragmatic, scalable ISMS solutions using our platform.

  • You independently guide customers through audits and certifications such as ISO 27001 and TISAX®.

  • You use AI to automate repetitive consulting work, accelerate analysis and preparation, and free up more time for high-value customer interaction and problem-solving.

  • You experiment with new AI-powered ways of working and help shape how we use AI across InfoSec consulting, turning successful approaches into scalable best practices.

  • You support Sales and Customer Success in identifying and developing cross-selling and up-selling opportunities with existing customers.

  • You bring customer and technical insights back into the organisation, helping us continuously improve our InfoSec product, tooling and consulting approach.

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

  • The freedom, trust, and tools you need to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company.

  • A competitive salary, flexible working hours tailored to your needs, and benefits catering to health, family, and sustainability.

  • A secure and future-proof job with a professional working atmosphere and the dynamics of a maturing scale-up.

  • The opportunity to develop into a mentoring role, empowering and supporting up-and-coming talent.

  • The opportunity and budget to further develop your existing skills and build new ones, including in AI and information security.

  • Lots of responsibility and the opportunity to actively shape and define the future of Security & Compliance, including how we use AI to work smarter and deliver more value to our customers.

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

  • You have 3+ years of professional experience in information security, IT security, GRC, compliance or a closely related field.

  • You are technically curious and genuinely excited about AI, automation and finding smarter ways to solve problems.

  • You already use AI tools in your work or are hungry to experiment, learn quickly and help shape how AI can improve information security consulting.

  • You enjoy working directly with customers, can challenge their thinking when needed and turn complex technical or regulatory requirements into clear, pragmatic solutions.

  • You take ownership, work independently and look for ways to improve how things are done rather than simply following existing processes.

  • You have excellent German and English communication skills.

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OUR HEARTS

No matter your origin, ethnicity, gender identity, religion or individual requirements; at DataGuard, all that counts is the person you are. As Guards and Guardettes, we are united not only by our dedication, but also by our shared belief in our purpose: Protect the people behind the data. Convince us with your personality and your skills – and together we will make great things happen. We are looking forward to meeting you!

title: Senior IoT Engineer (all genders) – Embedded Linux · Python · Yocto
description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior IoT Engineer (all genders), you join our Devices team and bridge both worlds: you own our Yocto-based Linux software platform and actively build the Python application services running on top of it. Python is your daily driver, but you go down to C/C++, drivers, and the kernel whenever hardware requires it. Neither pure BSP-only engineers nor high-level-only developers will be happy here - this is a true hybrid hands-on role.

Right now, we are building a new generalized Linux based platform for our next-generation hardware, harmonizing the software across all device types and making fleet health visible in real time. You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

WHAT TO EXPECT

title: Microwave Design Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

  • Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

  • Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a microwave design engineer, you will help build the basis for the millimeter wave hardware acting as the spark plug that initiates a fusion plasma and raises its temperature to greater than 100 million degrees. You’ll join the Alpha Heating System team ready to drive the integrated RF and thermo-mechanical design of high-power components, and help build and test these components in the lab before installing them at scale on our net scientific gain Alpha stellarator.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Provide innovative solutions to complex RF engineering challenges by collaborating closely with physicists to ensure component designs meet the Alpha plasma physics and thermal-mechanical constraints.

  • Develop designs and evaluate vendor designs to determine an optimal path to efficiently deliver our power to the stellarator - driving down the denominator of input power that will limit fusion power plant gain Q=Pout/Pin - and drive down costs.

  • Draw from and contribute to our stellarator development process, interfacing your RF components with other stellarator systems.

  • Contribute to mechanical and thermal analysis and sensitivity studies for component viability under the loads and stresses imposed by the combination of vacuum, magnetic fields, temperatures, and MW-scale RF loads.

  • Interface with the Alpha project management teams to realize the delivery of RF components and meet the tight Proxima timelines.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A highly capable RF engineer with experience in millimeter waves and knowledge of the tools and best practices for design of these systems

  • Demonstrated familiarly with RF modeling codes - SURF3D, CST, COMSOL, GdfidL, openEMS, even self-developed python codes or ones plasma physics community hasn’t heard of - capable of performing modeling at 200 GHz frequencies

  • Experience validating first-of-a-kind designs with uncertain performance, working as part of a team on multi-scale and multi-physics simulations, testing, and prototyping.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively.

  • Experience with gyrotrons and associated components - transmission systems, launcher antennas, rf loads; experience with plasma physics is a plus.

  • Understanding of quasi optical propagation of millimeter waves; ray tracing and where it breaks down

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)


*This role sits at "L2-L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are looking to add a Senior Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of communication system architectures, operational concepts, requirements, and system-level performance analysis for advanced communication terminals and networks. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success. 

The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content. 


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces.
  • Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe.
  • Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility.
  • Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations.
  • Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability.
  • Lead system-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration
  • Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance.
  • Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation. 

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms.
  • Very strong background in communication theory.
  • Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation).
  • Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS).
  • Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews.
  • Fluent in English (German language skills a plus).
  • Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance. 

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team.
  • High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.

At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We are looking to add a Senior RF Hardware Engineer to our team. If you are great at what you do, enjoy working in a startup environment, and are passionate about developing leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. 

At the Senior II level, you will be tasked with full-stack hardware development for complex modules and small systems. You will have the opportunity to start at concept development and progress through detailed design, analysis, layout, build, test, and delivery, doing hands-on work at each phase. The Senior II level also introduces technical leadership opportunities, gaining responsibility for small teams of hardware engineers developing new products and systems.

  • Own the development of hardware modules and subsystems from requirements through schematic capture, layout, integration, verification, and production release.

  • Provide technical support for field trials, demonstrations, customer evaluations, and deployment activities.

  • Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics, including trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design.

Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market.

What you will work on

Your mission

Drive initiatives that grow Emidat. In Growth we prioritise by one question: does this bring in new customers? As a Growth Engineer Intern you work across our four growth functions that sits closest to that answer; 1. Growth Engineering, 2. Growth Marketing, 3. Sales Development and 4. Partnerships

Topics you might work on: our automated campaign planning and lead development process, and the automations behind it. Our mapping of the total addressable market (TAM) and the GTM analysis sheet we use to decide which segments and countries to go after. Our industry get-togethers, for example expert exchanges and C-level breakfasts, from the invite list to the follow-up. LinkedIn posts and customer case studies, which means talking to manufacturers who use Emidat and turning what they tell you into material our sales team can send.

Building a revenue function is one of the most difficult parts of founding, and during your internship, you’ll get insights into how demand is created, how a pipeline is built, and how AI actually optimises a go-to-market team. You will work on initiatives with the leads of each growth function, including our Head of Growth. During your Internship, you will:

title: Workday Financial Systems Architect
description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us!

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique.


Why Systems at AMBOSS?

AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care.

Why can this position be exciting for you?

You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module.

You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day.

This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue.

Where we are

Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead.

You will:

  • Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model.

  • Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work.

  • Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant.

  • Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved.

  • Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions.

  • Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible.

  • Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it.

You bring:

  • Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases).

  • Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags).

  • Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT.

  • Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools.

  • Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements.

  • Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use.

  • Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT

  • Proficiency in German

  • Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations

  • Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara

  • Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate

  • A Workday consulting or CoE background

  • A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context

You enjoy:

  • Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months.

  • Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands.

  • Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait.

  • Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first.

What success looks like after your first year:

  • The tenant runs without the implementation partner.

  • The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does.

  • The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end.

  • Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on.

Benefits:

🌴 Rest & Time Off (30 paid vacation days, AMBOSS holiday, personal purpose day and more)

🥙Food & Office Comfort (Daily healthy breakfast & lunch by in-house chef in Berlin HQ, AMBOSS daycare, work remotely from other office spaces in Cologne, Sardinia, Cape Town)

🏃 Health, Fitness & Mobility (Urban Sports Club -M plan- , Fitbit Versa 3, Deutschland Ticket…)

Check out the full list of benefits below:

https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

That’s why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone—regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity—is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care 🩺

title: Data Scientist
description:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

  • Investigate detection performance deeply: dig into missed cases, alert quality, and pattern drift, and turn what you find into concrete tuning or configuration changes.

  • Translate technical findings into customer-facing insight: build the analysis that shows investigator productivity gains, false positive cost reduction, and detection effectiveness improvements in language a customer's compliance and risk leadership actually uses.

  • Sit in the room with customers directly. Present findings, defend your methodology to a customer's own data science or compliance team, and answer the hard “why did the model do this” questions live.

  • Partner closely with your regional Customer Value Partners on account strategy, informing where the model needs to change to unlock the next stage of value realization or a renewal conversation.

  • Feed patterns and findings back into Hawk's broader model and product functions, distinguishing between “this customer needs local tuning” and “this is a systemic gap worth fixing centrally.”

  • Own the regulatory defensibility of the tuning decisions you make. Document your reasoning so a customer's audit or regulator review holds up.

  • Bring rigor to how you validate model changes before they go live: backtesting, sample review, and sign-off discipline that protects the customer's compliance posture.

Your Profile

  • 5-7 years as a data scientist in a customer-facing role, presenting analysis and defending model decisions directly to clients. This is not an internal-facing engineering or product data science background; you've sat across the table from a customer before.

  • Real experience in AML, fraud detection, or financial crime analytics is required. You understand transaction monitoring, typologies, and what a false positive actually costs an investigator, not just what one costs on a confusion matrix.

  • Strong hands-on skills in the standard data science stack (Python, SQL, and whatever ML tooling you've used in production), but your edge is judgment under ambiguity: knowing when a model change is safe to make and when it needs a human in the loop.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in a room with a customer's risk, compliance, or data science stakeholders, and holding your own when questioned.

  • A track record of translating model performance into business value a non-technical stakeholder can act on: not just accuracy metrics, but investigator hours saved, false positive cost avoided, and cases caught.

  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and live production systems. You're not looking for a clean offline research problem, you're looking for the “why did this alert fire on a real customer's data at 2pm today” problem.

  • An ownership mentality. You don't wait for a ticket; you notice when an account's detection performance is drifting and you go find out why.

Bonus

  • Experience specifically in transaction monitoring or payments fraud detection at a bank, payment provider, or a vendor serving them.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI and rules-based hybrid detection approaches, since that's core to how Hawk's models work.

We’ve studied and worked at institutions and companies including Stanford, TUM, Google, EA, and YC-backed AI startups.

The role

As our Founding Product Manager, you will help determine what BoWatt builds, why we build it, and whether it creates meaningful value for customers.

You will work closely across our commercial, customer success and engineering teams, as well as with our customers. You will develop a deep understanding of complex engineering workflows, turn customer problems into clear product opportunities, and drive initiatives from discovery through launch and iteration.

This is a hands-on product role. You will spend time with customers, work through technical and operational detail, write requirements, make trade-offs, test solutions, and help the team ship quickly.

  • Lead product discovery - translate complex workflows and customer needs into clear product requirements and success criteria

  • Develop a deep understanding of how manufacturing and systems-engineering teams work

  • Identify and define the highest-value customer problems for BoWatt to solve

  • Help own and prioritise the product roadmap

  • Balance strategic opportunities, recurring customer needs, commercial importance, and engineering effort

  • Drive product initiatives from initial discovery through scoping, development, launch, and iteration

  • Give engineers the context and clarity needed to make strong implementation decisions

  • Prototype and test potential solutions with customers before and during development

  • Work with Customer Success to turn individual customer feedback into scalable product improvements

  • Use qualitative feedback and product data to understand adoption and evaluate whether features are working

  • Triage product issues and bugs, make clear prioritisation decisions, and coordinate with Engineering

  • Improve BoWatt’s processes for discovery, prioritisation, product delivery, launches, and feedback

  • Develop deep expertise in BoWatt’s product, customers, and target industries

During your first six months, you will work closely with our engineering team to build the domain and product knowledge required to take ownership of increasingly important product areas.

You

  • You are deeply curious about customers and want to understand how their work actually happens

  • You enjoy turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear product decisions

  • You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • You can distinguish between an individual customer request and a scalable product opportunity

  • You make thoughtful trade-offs and are comfortable deciding with incomplete information

  • You write clearly, communicate confidently, and know how to get to the point

  • You are comfortable working closely with software engineers and discussing technical constraints

  • You move quickly without losing sight of product quality or customer outcomes

  • You take ownership of results rather than simply managing tickets and meetings

  • You want to build a product function rather than inherit an established playbook

  • You are ambitious, resourceful, and excited to become an expert in a complex industry

Requirements

  • At least two years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Product Operations, or a comparable product-building role

  • Experience shipping B2B software in close collaboration with engineers

  • Experience conducting product discovery and translating customer problems into clear requirements

  • Strong prioritisation, project management, and stakeholder-management skills

  • The ability to understand technical products and communicate with engineers, technical users, and business stakeholders

  • Fluent German required; English is our internal working language

  • Four days per week in our Munich office at Balanstraße

  • Experience with enterprise software, AI products, manufacturing, engineering, systems engineering, or early-stage startups is a bonus

What we offer

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Participation in BoWatt’s Founders Pool: 5–10% virtual equity package

  • Significant ownership over an important part of BoWatt’s product

  • The opportunity to help build BoWatt’s product function and ways of working

  • 25 vacation days per year, plus public holidays

  • Company retreats

  • WellPass membership

The Founders Pool

BoWatt’s Founders Pool is a dedicated virtual-equity pool for a small group of early team members who take responsibility for building and leading a major part of the company.

 

We created it because we want the people building BoWatt alongside us to participate meaningfully in the value they help create. These are not narrow execution roles with finished playbooks. You will own your vertical with co-founder-like autonomy and accountability: setting the standard, making difficult trade-offs, and being responsible for the results.

 

As our Founding Product Manager, you will participate in the Founders Pool (5-10%) and take meaningful ownership of how BoWatt’s product develops. The precise allocation, vesting structure, and plan terms will be discussed transparently during the interview process.

Interview process

  1. 20-minute screening call

  2. 90-minute live product case (CEO and team member)

  3. 60-minute culture interview (CEO)

  4. Reference checks & Offer

We aim to complete the entire interview process within 14 days.
