The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

  • Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened.

  • Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on.

  • Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures.

  • Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day.

  • Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively.

  • Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up.

Key Requirements:

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Your Role

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Lead to build and lead a high-performing commercial function that drives strategic customer relationships and secures high-value contracts with both government customers and large enterprises (primarily satellite primes and OEMs).

You'll own the path from shaping opportunities before tenders open, through leading competitive proposals, to securing multi-year contracts and driving sustained account growth. Your ability to navigate complex, high-stakes deals, foster a results-driven culture, and partner with our engineering and business teams will directly influence NewOrbit's market leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Dual-market ownership (Gov & Enterprise): Build and execute account strategies for agencies and large companies; map stakeholders, budgets, and decision paths; shape requirements before tenders open.

  • Tender intelligence & capture: Track pipelines across government portals and enterprise sourcing calendars; run capture plans, win themes, and competitor/price-to-win analyses; lead bid/no-bid decisions.

  • Proposal leadership: Orchestrate compliant submissions; coordinate clarifications, BAFO, and oral presentations.

  • Complex deal negotiation: Close supply, licensing, and co-development agreements; negotiate IP, warranties/liability, service levels, and milestone payments aligned to TRL gates.

  • Partnerships & consortia: Structure teaming with primes, SMEs, universities, and test partners to strengthen bids and delivery confidence.

  • Forecasting & governance: Maintain a transparent pipeline with stage gating, ACV/TCV, probability, and cycle metrics; report risks/mitigations and drive executive decision forums.

  • Voice of customer: Feed market and procurement insights into roadmaps, qualification timelines, pricing, and make/buy decisions.

  • Compliance & controls: Work with Legal/Compliance on export control (UK/EU/US regimes), information security, and public-sector procurement rules.

  • Market presence & pitching: Represent NewOrbit at industry events, tender briefings, space conferences, and executive reviews; deliver compelling pitches and presentations that clearly communicate our vision and value proposition.

  • Team leadership: Build, mentor, and inspire a high-performing commercial team, fostering persistence, creativity, and a results-driven culture.

Fundamental Requirements

  • Space industry experience (required): Must have direct experience selling satellites or space hardware - payloads, cameras, antennas, subsystems. Candidates without space industry sales experience will not be considered.

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in business development or key accounts, with wins across government procurement and large-enterprise buying centres.

  • Customer knowledge: Up to date on where satellite/space hardware customers are coming from today, across government, primes, and OEMs - not relying on outdated relationships.

  • Full sales cycle ownership: Demonstrated experience across all stages - pre-tender shaping, capture planning, proposal/bid leadership, negotiation, and contract close.

  • Tender mastery: Demonstrated success leading competitive bids (capture planning, scoring criteria, compliance, pricing) and handling long, multi-stakeholder cycles.

  • Deal craft: Strong negotiation track record on MSAs/SOWs, licensing, co-development, and milestone-based contracts; fluent in IP and risk allocation.

  • Domain fluency: Able to translate complex engineering (propulsion, LEO satellite platforms, qualification, test/readiness reviews) into customer value and business cases.

  • Leadership & mentoring: Proven ability to recruit, develop, and manage high-performing commercial or sales teams.

  • Process & tools: Disciplined CRM usage, forecasting, and KPI ownership (win rate, cycle time, stage conversion, ACV/TCV).

  • Governance & compliance: Familiarity with public-sector procurement practices and export-control considerations; knows when to engage specialists.

  • Marketing savvy: Skilled in shaping and delivering impactful presentations, narratives, and proposals that resonate with diverse audiences.

  • Soft skills: Executive presence, exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, stakeholder influence, and resilience in long negotiations.

  • Ways of working: High ownership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment; willing to travel for customer meetings, briefings, and negotiations.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience at a small satellite company that scaled into a large business - candidates who've operated through that growth curve are especially well suited to this role.

 

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: VP, Strategic Finance
description:
Team: Finance (G&A)

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses.

Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started.

We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players.

Why this role & why now

You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it.

What you will own

Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve.

Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them.

Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions.

Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers.

Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it.

Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable.

What good looks like

First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order.

90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180.

Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them.

The standard

A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised.

Three things must not fail in this role.

  • Timeliness: deadlines are commitments, not targets.

  • Quality: every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team.

  • Capacity: within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip.

That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing.

What you bring

  • A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on.

  • You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role.

  • You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide.

  • A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you.

  • You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month.

  • You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early.

Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders.

What this role is not

It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you.

It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it.

What we offer

Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down. If you see a problem, you can fix it.

Our current benefits include:

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant, remote-first company culture

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • Participation in our equity programme

  • Genuine opportunities for growth: we promote from within and invest in your development

  • The chance to join during an expansion phase and shape how Nivoda operates at scale

Interview Process

  • Screening conversation with Talent Acquisition

  • Structured career-history interview with Hiring Manager

  • Focus interview: you present a case study to a panel from Finance and the leadership team

  • Final conversation with the C-suite

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you meet most of this description and not all of it, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role? Join our Talent Pool

If this isn’t quite the right fit but you’re excited about what Nivoda is building, we’d still love to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when the right opportunity comes along.

title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
description:
👫  About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️  What you'll do

  • Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

  • Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

  • Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.

  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

  • Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪  About you

We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.

You will ideally have:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

  • A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

  • A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

  • Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

  • Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

  • Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.

  • A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands.

👊 Growth Expectations

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.

Within 6 months, you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.

Within 12 months, you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.

title: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
description:
Senior Vet Surgeon

Salary up to £75,000 DOE

Relocation Allowance up to £5,000 plus a Welcome Bonus of up to £5000

 

Dragon Vets, part of inspiring vet care, are seeking an enthusiastic Veterinary Surgeon to join our Rissington site as a Senior Vet, The role will require you to help shape the future of the branch by developing the staff and supporting senior management to ensure the site thrives.

 

We promote further growth and development within the team, giving you access to a large client base with a wide variety of cases, equipment, CPD and a supportive team. In this role you will be working with a large team of dedicated Vets, Nurses and support team members to deliver excellent client and patient care.

 
The role will be based at our Rissington branch and is a full-time position, working four days per week.
 

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

Practice Highlights

 

Located in the heart of Cheltenham, renowned for horse racing and a thriving bar and restaurant scene, Dragon Vets is an established practice and has invested in specialist equipment including CT, DR, rigid and flexible endoscopy, high-end Doppler ultrasonography and well-equipped operating facilities including laparoscopic kits and TPLO kits, and much more.

 

We have a team of 16 vets, including certificate holders with Advanced Practitioner status in Small Animal Surgery, Cardiology and Medicine, and value evidence-based medicine with regular clinical discussions and readily available colleague support.

 

We function as more than a first-opinion practice, often performing complex surgeries and treating intensive medical cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in caseload.

 

We have a dedicated, separate out-of-hours team – Vets Now – based within the same building, enabling 24-hour care. Our nursing team is made up of 17 RVNs and 4 SVNs in various stages of their training.

 

Working Pattern

 
* Average of 37 hours per week over 4 days
* 1 in 4 Saturday mornings
* No out-of-hours or on-call requirements
* Flexible options available for both part-time and full-time applicants
 

Here's what the team have to say

 

"I started at Dragon Vets nine years ago working after school as an ACA. After leaving to go to vet school, I was welcomed back into the team as a new graduate vet in 2023. Dragon have given me a supportive and exciting start to my career. We are lucky to have the facilities in house to advance diagnostics and care beyond first opinion. I enjoy working with all the team and am proud to be a part of it." – Sofia, Vet.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you will be the most senior veterinary clinician within the practice, responsible for leading clinical standards, governance and the delivery of outstanding patient and client care.

 

You’ll provide clinical leadership to the veterinary team, oversee complex cases and act as the primary source of clinical guidance and decision-making within the practice. Working closely with the senior practice leadership team, you’ll support the strategic direction of the practice and drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, outcomes and ways of working.

 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are a highly experienced veterinary surgeon with strong clinical expertise and a passion for leadership and clinical excellence. You’ll bring:

 
* A Veterinary degree and registration with the RCVS, with significant experience in small or mixed animal practice, including advanced surgical and medical capability
* Proven experience in mentoring, coaching and supporting veterinary colleagues
* Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills
* Experience contributing to or leading clinical governance, audits and quality improvement initiatives
* The ability to manage clinical complaints and provide professional guidance in complex situations
* Professionalism, integrity and a commitment to the highest standards of patient and client care
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement

* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees

Solution Consulting is not an established playbook you're stepping into. You're building it. You'll decide how we sell, what our demos look like, how we structure technical validation, and how the function scales as the team grows. You won't be stepping into someone else's playbook. You'll be shaping the entire GTM motion for our most important market.

You'll own & define the technical and business case throughout the sales cycles - from discovery through demo(s), supporting RFPs, and defining the solution approach. Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

title: AI Software Engineer (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Preferred (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés :

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

  • 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent...

  • +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute.

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts (Individual Contributor / IC), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.

▪️ À propos du poste

Tu conçois et déploies des agents IA et systèmes agentiques complets exécutant des processus métier de bout en bout : support client avancé, recherche multi-sources, opérations IT, ainsi que des cas d'usage avancés liés à l'industrie du futur et à la continuité digitale (ex. traçabilité des exigences, maintenance prédictive, continuité de l'ingénierie et jumeaux numériques). Tu sais aussi bien développer des agents sur-mesure en code que configurer des agents via des plateformes low-code/no-code avec des plateformes type Gemini Enterprise.

Ton terrain d'action combine maîtrise technique du cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) et compréhension fonctionnelle fine des enjeux métiers. Tu orchestres l'autonomie des agents, la planification, le choix des outils et la mémoire, tout en garantissant la fiabilité, la gouvernance et le respect des garde-fous.

Les missions :

  • Analyser et appréhender les besoins et processus métiers avec une vision fonctionnelle claire pour définir les cas d'usage d'automatisation et la répartition des tâches (autonomie agentique vs validation humaine).

  • Concevoir et développer des systèmes agentiques complets (mono ou multi-agents), en choisissant l'approche adaptée : développement sur-mesure ou programmation/configuration d'agents low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, Vertex AI Agent Builder, AWS).

  • Construire les outils des agents : function calling, intégration d’API et de systèmes d’information, création et consommation de serveurs MCP, workflows asynchrones et longue durée.

  • Maîtriser la fiabilité : gestion des erreurs et des reprises, boucles de contrôle, limites de budget et de pas, comportement face à l’imprévu.

  • Évaluer les agents : jeux de scénarios, analyse des trajectoires, taux de réussite des tâches, LLM-as-judge, tests de non-régression à chaque changement de prompt, d’outil ou de modèle.

  • Observer en production : traces détaillées, coûts par tâche, détection des dérives et des boucles, tableaux de bord.

  • Sécuriser l’autonomie : permissions minimales sur les outils, protection contre la prompt injection, isolation des actions sensibles, validation humaine, traçabilité, conformité (RGPD, AI Act).

  • S'intégrer dans le cycle de vie logiciel (SDLC) complet et déployer sur le cloud (Google Cloud / Vertex AI) avec intégration CI/CD et gestion des coûts.

  • Partager : documenter les patterns, former les équipes clientes, contribuer aux publications et événements SFEIR.

▪️ Le profil idéal

  • 5 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel (hors stage et alternance) avec une vision transverse du SDLC et une première expérience solide sur des projets LLM / IA
  • Pratique démontrée de la création d'agents IA : développement custom (frameworks/code) ou création via des environnements low-code/no-code (Gemini Enterprise, AWS,...)
  • Connaissance de MCP et des protocoles d’interopérabilité entre agents (A2A)
  • Compréhension fine des modes d’échec des agents : dérive, boucles, mauvais choix d’outil, perte de contexte
  • Solide maîtrise des API, de l’asynchrone et des architectures événementielles
  • Rigueur d’ingénierie : tests, observabilité, code relu
  • Aisance relationnelle et bon niveau fonctionnel pour échanger avec les équipes métiers, comprendre leurs enjeux et leur expliquer les possibilités et limites des agents IA

Un plus

  • Expérience d’évaluation d’agents et d’observabilité (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse…)
  • Connaissance de la méthodologie BMAD 
  • Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Cloud Run, Gemini),
  • Sensibilité sécurité : modèles de menaces sur les agents, gestion des identités et des permissions
  • Notions de RAG, vues comme un outil de l’agent
  • Contributions open source, side projects agentiques, talks

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais 

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence.

▪️ Tes conditions de travail

  • Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).
  • Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant.

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

  1. Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR.
  2. Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo et GenAI) avec deux Sfeirians.
  3. Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux
  4. Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence.

title: Strategic Partner Account Manager DACH
description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.


Key Responsibilities:

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding:

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets.

  • Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity.

  • Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

    • Partner Relationship Management:

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

    • Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement:

  • Develop and execute joint business plans with partners to achieve mutually agreed-upon revenue targets.

  • Provide ongoing sales enablement, training, and support to partners, including product updates, competitive intelligence, and sales collateral.

  • Collaborate with internal sales teams to ensure seamless hand-off and co-selling opportunities with partners.

  • Track and report on partner performance metrics, including pipeline, closed deals, and revenue attribution.

    • Forecasting & Reporting:

  • Accurately forecast partner sales and contribute to overall company revenue projections.

  • Provide regular reports on partner performance, activities, and market insights to management.

    • Program Development & Optimization:

  • Contribute to the ongoing development and refinement of the channel partner program, including policies, incentives, and marketing initiatives.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and GTM teams to support partner needs and program enhancements.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and best practices in channel management


    • Qualifications:
  • Confident Communicator. Languages: Native German language, English fluent. 

  • You have at least 2-3 years of experience, ideally in partnership development, in a competitive, data-driven environment. 

  • You have a strong understanding of SaaS business models and an interest in technology

  • Analytical and strategic thinking abilities, KPI driven approach.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.

    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey.

Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a talented Account Executive to join our Paris office who will focus on French market. 
 
This role involves engaging qualified prospects, demoing the Aircall solution, providing technical assistance, successfully navigating a proof of concept and negotiating contracts. It is a fast-paced role that fits high energy and smart sales people.

Key responsabilities
  • Use outbound selling strategies to create pipeline and find new business
  • Manage prospects from qualified lead to closing
  • Position and articulate the Aircall value proposition to medium businesses.
  • Educate prospects through complex sales-cycles in order to create excitement and enthusiasm across multiple stakeholders
  • Work side by side with Sales Development Representatives and Partner Account Managers to identify business opportunities and accelerate your existing pipeline
  • Consistently prospect to maintain strong pipeline coverage and consistent quota attainment
  • Represent Aircall with integrity and professionalism at all times in all written and oral communications

    • Qualifications:
  • A proven experience as a B2B Account Executive or similar sales role in SaaS is mandatory
  • Fluent in French and English, being able to exchange in Italian or Hebrew is a plus.
  • Experience with Salesforce and revenue engagement tools such as Gong, Outreach, Salesloft
  • A knowledge of sales methodologies such as SPICED / MEDDIC is a plus
  • A proactive, driven seller able to identify and communicate business pains and outcomes, drive urgency and take end to end ownership for quota attainment
  • Successful track record of closing net new business and generating your own pipeline
  • Demonstrable organisational and time management skills
  • Competitive and driven to achieve goals, build new skills and bring new ideas on how to do things faster and better!
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.

title: Senior Director, Brand Partnerships EMEA
description:
👫  About the team

Equativ's EMEA Demand team is responsible for growing relationships with agencies, advertisers, DSPs and other demand partners across the region, helping them leverage Equativ's full suite of omnichannel advertising solutions.

As we continue to strengthen our position with the world's leading agencies, we are also increasing our engagement directly with brands - understanding their business and media challenges, and ensuring Equativ's capabilities are represented in the conversations that shape future investment.

We are looking for a Senior Director EMEA, Brand Partnerships to define and lead this strategy, reporting to our VP Demand, EMEA.

This role is about creating stronger connections between brands, their agencies and Equativ, helping us build more strategic relationships with advertisers while creating incremental opportunities for our existing agency ecosystem.

This is a highly visible, entrepreneurial role for someone who knows the European advertising industry exceptionally well, has strong relationships with senior marketers, and can build a new commercial motion from the ground up.

✍️  What you'll do

  • Define and lead Equativ’s EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, identifying priority brands, verticals and markets, and building a scalable plan to strengthen Equativ’s position with advertisers across the region.

  • Build senior relationships with leading brands, engaging CMOs, Media Directors, Digital, Programmatic and Marketing leaders to understand their priorities and position Equativ as a strategic partner across programmatic, CTV, data, curation, commerce media and omnichannel activation.

  • Work closely with Equativ’s agency teams and partners to ensure Brand Direct initiatives complement — rather than compete with — existing agency relationships. Develop coordinated account strategies for shared clients and identify opportunities to create incremental value for both brands and their agencies.

  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships, from initial engagement through proposals, joint business plans, pilots and long-term agreements, while building a strong pipeline of advertiser opportunities across EMEA.

  • Act as the voice of the advertiser within Equativ, bringing market insight back to Product, Marketing and Commercial teams, helping shape Equativ’s proposition and representing the company across key advertiser forums, industry events and senior-level conversations.

💪  About you

We are looking for someone who combines industry relationships, strategic thinking and commercial execution.

You will ideally have:

  • 10+ years of experience in advertising technology, digital media, programmatic advertising, media, data or a related sector.

  • A strong and active network of senior brand-side relationships across EMEA, particularly among CMOs, Media Directors, Heads of Digital, Programmatic and Marketing.

  • A proven track record of opening doors and building meaningful commercial relationships directly with major advertisers.

  • Deep knowledge of the European advertising ecosystem and a strong understanding of how brands, agency holding companies, independent agencies, trading desks and technology platforms work together.

  • Strong knowledge of programmatic advertising and the broader adtech ecosystem, including DSPs, SSPs, CTV, data, identity, curation and omnichannel media.

  • Experience developing sophisticated strategic partnerships, annual agreements or Joint Business Plans with large advertisers.

  • A demonstrated ability to turn senior relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The ability to navigate complex brand/agency dynamics with diplomacy, transparency and sound commercial judgement.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with C-level marketing executives.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset: you are comfortable building a strategy and operating model where there is not yet a complete playbook.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • Strong internal collaboration skills and the ability to bring multiple stakeholders together around shared commercial objectives.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across EMEA.

Above all, you should be someone who is deeply connected to the advertising industry, intellectually curious about where the market is heading, and excited about helping Equativ build a significantly stronger position with the world's leading brands.

👊 Growth Expectations

Within your first 90 days, you will have developed a deep understanding of Equativ's EMEA demand business, product portfolio and existing agency relationships. You will have identified priority advertiser accounts and verticals, established an initial EMEA Brand Partnerships strategy, and defined clear rules of engagement between Brand Direct and Agency teams.

Within 6 months, you will have developed senior relationships across a focused portfolio of strategic advertisers, built a meaningful pipeline of opportunities, launched the first strategic partnerships or pilots, and demonstrated an effective model for collaborating with agencies on shared clients.

Within 12 months, you will have established a repeatable Brand Partnerships motion across EMEA, generated measurable incremental revenue and strategic product adoption, built a portfolio of flagship advertiser relationships, and created the foundation for Equativ to further scale its Brand Direct organisation.

title: Lead Data Scientist H/F
description:
Volta Medical is an innovative, data-inspired US and European-based growth MedTech aimed at creating and bringing to the market cutting-edge AI software products to revolutionize interventional cardiac electrophysiology.  

Volta has created a data collection and enrichment ecosystem for curated EP lab data which is fed into a physician validated, machine learning methodology to support complex AF solutions. Our newest technology, Volta AF-Xplorer II, is a data-driven AI decision support system that easily integrates into the standard physician workflow, providing a patient-tailored approach to complex AF and AT procedures.  

Our dynamic, innovative team is made up of 100+ collaborators in the EU and USA from a wide variety of backgrounds including engineers, business professionals and physicians, working together to develop AI solutions that help electrophysiologists help patients.


Mission

As Lead Data Science, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Volta's AI technology. You will lead a multidisciplinary Data Science team and contribute directly to the development of innovative machine learning solutions embedded in medical devices used daily in electrophysiology labs worldwide. 

Reporting to the VP Innovation, you will combine scientific expertise, technical leadership and people management to drive the development of next-generation AI algorithms while ensuring compliance with medical device quality and regulatory standards.


Your Responsibilities 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and drive the Data Science roadmap in alignment with product and business priorities.  

  • Lead the design, development and validation of state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms.  

  • Ensure scientific excellence and promote best practices in AI research and development.  

  • Stay up to date with the latest advances in AI and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into Volta's products.  

  • Support the definition of data strategies and contribute to the continuous improvement of data collection pipelines.  

Team Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor and grow a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and PhD researchers.  

  • Foster a collaborative, innovative and high-performance culture.  

  • Coach team members in both technical and professional development.  

  • Coordinate priorities, allocate resources and ensure timely project delivery.  

Product Development 

  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineering, Clinical, Regulatory and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.  

  • Contribute to software architecture discussions involving AI components.  

  • Ensure production-ready, maintainable and high-quality code.  

  • Participate in the preparation of technical documentation required for regulatory submissions.  

Scientific & External Collaboration 

  • Represent Volta Medical at scientific conferences and technical events.  

  • Contribute to publications, patents and collaborations with academic partners.  

  • Communicate AI strategy and technical achievements to executive leadership, partners and investors. 


Your Profile

Education & Experience 

  • PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or a related field.  

  • 10+ years of experience developing Machine Learning solutions in an industrial R&D environment.  

  • 5+ years of experience leading technical teams or mentoring Data Scientists.  

  • Experience working in regulated environments (Medical Devices, Healthcare, Automotive, Aerospace or similar) is a strong plus.  

  • Experience bringing AI models from research to production.  

Technical Skills 

  • Strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and statistical modeling.  

  • Excellent understanding of model development, evaluation and deployment.  

  • Strong programming skills in Python.  

  • Experience with PyTorch, Scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas and related ML libraries.  

  • Familiarity with software engineering best practices (Git, testing, CI/CD, Docker).  

  • Good knowledge of Linux environments.  

  • Experience with cloud computing and MLOps is a plus.  

  • Signal processing knowledge would be highly appreciated.  

Soft Skills 

  • Strong leadership and coaching abilities.  

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.  

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.  

  • Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.  

  • Fluent English (spoken and written). 


Why join Volta Medical? 

Artificial Intelligence is transforming healthcare, and Volta Medical is at the forefront of this revolution. 

Joining us means contributing to cutting-edge medical technologies that directly improve patients' lives while working alongside internationally recognized experts in electrophysiology, AI and medical devices. 

At Volta, you will enjoy: 

  • Meaningful work with real clinical impact.  

  • An international, multidisciplinary and collaborative environment.  

  • The opportunity to work on state-of-the-art AI applied to healthcare.  

  • High autonomy and opportunities for professional growth.  

  • Regular scientific exchanges and innovation-driven culture.  

  • A workplace located in Marseille, offering an exceptional Mediterranean lifestyle. 

Volta Medical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage qualified individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact on healthcare, we'd love to hear from you! 


Recruitment Process
  • Introductory & Culture Fit interview with our Senior VP People (45 min)
  • Technical & Leadership interview with our VP Innovation and our CTO (90min)
  • Interview with our CEO (60 min)
  • Coffee chat at our Marseille HQ (120 min) 
    Spend time with the Data Science team, our Chief Clinical & Regulatory Officer, and our Co-founders (Julien/Clément). Discover our working environment, exchange ideas, and get a feel for what it's like to build AI solutions at Volta Medical.

title: Solution Architect / Solution Engineer
description:
Une nouvelle vision de la billetterie, au service du monde de la culture, des événements en direct, des loisirs et du sport.


Bienvenue chez vivenu, leader mondial de la billetterie événementielle et l'une des entreprises technologiques à la croissance la plus rapide au monde. Nous avons révolutionné la billetterie de sites et producteurs comme les Grammy Awards, les Golden Globes, Fondation Louis Vuitton, Fondation du Patrimoine, Le Mans FC transformant les process de billetterie et les données collectées lors des parcours de vente en avantage stratégique. Bénéficiant d’investissements à hauteur de 65 millions de dollars, vivenu permet aux organisateurs d'événements de mettre en avant leur identité, de transformer l’expérience client, et d'intégrer la billetterie de manière transparente dans leur écosystème numérique.


vivenu s’engage auprès de ses partenaires pour assurer un support d’excellence et pour répondre de façon simple à leurs enjeux en créant des expériences exceptionnelles.


Rejoignez-nous et participez à la transformation des métiers de la billetterie et du marketing.


En tant que Solution Architect, vos responsabilités comprendront:

  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des intégrations sur mesure (connexions API, systèmes d’authentification SSO, ERP, etc.) en vous appuyant sur les puissants outils proposés par vivenu.

  • Accompagner nos grands comptes dans la transformation de leurs boutiques en ligne existantes vers une architecture moderne, entièrement pilotée par nos API.

  • Collaborer avec les différentes parties prenantes techniques de nos clients — directeurs techniques, équipes informatiques, agences web externes, etc. — afin de comprendre leurs besoins et de définir des plans d’action clairs et concrets.

  • Veiller à ce que les attentes et les besoins des clients soient alignés avec les capacités de vivenu. Vous serez également le principal interlocuteur technique en interne pour traiter les problématiques complexes qui surviennent vente en période d’exploitation.

  • Utiliser des scripts, l’IA et le prototypage pour tester rapidement différentes solutions. Vous transformerez ensuite les solutions éprouvées en guides et modèles d’intégration réutilisables à l’échelle de l’entreprise.

  • Vous immerger dans des secteurs d’activité variés afin de relever de nouveaux défis techniques, de la conception initiale jusqu’à la mise en œuvre de la solution.

  • Intervenir en tant qu’expert technique aux côtés de nos équipes commerciales, en les conseillant sur l’architecture des solutions, la faisabilité des intégrations, les délais et les ressources nécessaires.

  • Rester impliqué tout au long de la phase de mise en œuvre afin de garantir que la solution livrée corresponde pleinement aux engagements pris auprès du client, tout en identifiant et en anticipant les éventuelles contraintes techniques en amont de la livraison.


    • Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir dans ce rôle :
  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en tant que Solution Architect, Ingénieur ou dans un rôle technique similaire.
  • Une expérience en développement ou une solide expertise technique, ainsi qu’une évolution assumée vers la relation client, les enjeux business et la conception de solutions.
  • Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des applications web, des API REST, des webhooks, de la modélisation des données et des interactions entre les différents composants des écosystèmes logiciels modernes.
  • Une capacité à lire et comprendre rapidement une documentation d’API, à écrire des scripts fonctionnels pour tester des solutions et à analyser ou déboguer du code généré par l’IA.
  • Une réelle aisance dans les échanges avec des clients exigeants, ainsi que la capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités simultanément et à cadrer les attentes avec assurance.
  • Un diplôme universitaire en informatique, en ingénierie ou dans un domaine scientifique ou technique connexe.
  • Français & Anglais courant (niveau C1/C2) requis afin d’assurer une communication fluide et professionnelle avec nos clients et partenaires francophones.
    • Pourquoi rejoindre vivenu ?
     
    Pour être au cœur de l’exploitation de clients de renommée mondiale, en redéfinissant l’expérience utilisateur, grâce à une technologie de rupture.
     
    Une croissance durable
    Nous nous développons durablement en mettant l’accent sur la rentabilité et sommes soutenus par des fonds d’investissement de premier plan. Cela signifie un investissement continu dans nos employés, nos produits et notre vision à long terme.

    Une emprise globale
    Nous sommes une équipe riche de sa diversité, axée sur le mérite — et répartie dans six bureaux dans le monde. Le talent et l'impact sont ce qui compte avant tout chez vivenu.
     
    Une croissance rapide
    Sifted classe vivenu parmi les scale-ups à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous sommes nourris par la volonté d’apprendre au quotidien et de nous améliorer continuement.
     
    Développer notre position de leaders et contribuer directement à la transformation de notre industrie
    Travaillez aux côtés de visionnaires — des fondateurs de Forbes 30 Under 30, aux lauréats du prix Executive of the Year. Chez vivenu, vous contribuerez à établir les nouvelles normes de l'industrie de la billetterie.

    Chez vivenu, nous croyons que nos employés sont la clé de notre succès – et que l’esprit audacieux et la diversité de nos collaborateurs sont une richesse. title: Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist
description:
The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist supports new customers through the Didomi onboarding cycle, from Kick-Off to deployment and handover to the Customer Success team. The role is the entry point into the Customer Onboarding career path and is performed under the guidance of the Onboarding unit manager.

The Senior Customer Onboarding Specialist builds knowledge of the Didomi product suite and of customer privacy needs, keeps customer data up to date in Planhat, and relays customer feedback to the relevant internal teams.

Key Activities : 

  • Manage a defined portfolio of new customers of lower complexity (Growth Business), with a volume adapted to the learning curve. 

  • Run the onboarding steps with support: Pre-Kick-Off, Kick-Off, setup and follow-up calls, Go-live monitoring, Platform Demo / QA, and closure

  • Deliver standard product training sessions and share FAQs and Help Center content so that customers become autonomous

  • Handle first-level implementation issues during the Onboarding phase and is an intermediate to the Support team.

  • Flag onboarding risks (ghost customers, blocked projects) and apply the standard reminder and escalation rules

  • Keep Planhat up to date in real time (owner, onboarding stage, date, tier, health, ghosting flag)

  • Gather customer context from the Account Executive before Kick-Off and prepare the handover documentation for the CSM or KAM

  • Collect customer feedback and log it for the Onboarding unit

  • Contribute, with support, to a transverse initiative (documentation, training content, FAQs)

Autonomy and Decision-making : 

  • Works under supervision and within defined onboarding playbooks and internal rules

  • Follows the standard onboarding process and prioritizes daily actions with guidance

  • Escalates technical complexity, blocked projects, and ghost-customer risks to the Onboarding unit manager,Product team or the Support team. 

  • Validates any workaround, exception, or on-hold decision with the Onboarding unit manager. 

Working Relationships :

  • Internal: Onboarding unit, Sales, Pre-Sales, CSM, Support, Product, Finance. 

  • External: Customers (platform users and operational contacts), agencies, partners. 

Required Skills and Competencies : 

  • Customer service mindset: empathy, teaching ability, and capacity to simplify

  • Basic understanding of SaaS products and web technologies

  • Ability to organize and prioritize several customer projects in parallel, with guidance

  • Rigor in updating CRM tools such as Planhat

  • Curiosity for product and privacy topics

  • Good verbal and written communication skills, and comfort with presenting in kick-off calls and training sessions

  • Full professional proficiency in English

  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes)

  • Case Study Presentation (1h)

description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  

 

 

About the Job

The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. This role is at the intersection of system engineering, integration, field deployments, and debugging.

We are looking for an engineer with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Robotics or relevant fields and at least 2 years of practical, hands-on experience working with real systems - and if they fail, you can help us figure out why. This is not an entry-level or new-graduate role.

You will help define and execute system-level test scenarios, support atypical and beta deployments, and act as a technical bridge between the field and the engineering team. You will help train our field engineers and keep them in touch with fast evolving autonomy capabilities.

What you will do

  • Validate system behavior across machines, environments, and operating conditions

  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and operational limits

  • Collaborate with engineering teams on making technical decisions on a system level

  • Investigate system failure during field testing or deployments

  • Apply hotfixes when appropriate

  • Support or conduct deployments if needed, especially pilots or beta customers

  • Support/conduct atypical deployments, pilots, and beta customers

  • Capture lessons learned from deployments and feed them back into system testing and design

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact


    • What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a closely related field

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience working with complex systems (automation, robotics, vehicles, heavy machinery, industrial equipment, or similar)

  • Strong system-level troubleshooting and debugging skills

  • C++ and Python programming skills, proficiency in git systems

  • Proficiency in Linux systems

  • Comfortable working in field environments (construction sites, test yards, deployments)

  • Ability to travel abroad, according to needs of the business

  • Driver’s license B category


    • Beneficial

  • Experience with excavators, heavy equipment, or off-road vehicles

  • Field testing experience

  • Familiarity with communication technologies such as DDS, Zenoh, LCM etc.

  • Experience in motion planning or control

  • Experience in robotic competitions

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.
